report: Revision field theory (SPEC sections 1-4, 6): vielbein, canonical spin connection, Lagrangian, Euler-Lagrange equations, non-triviality [1] and [2], current, energy-momentum tensor, canonical quantisation; both statistics, verified exactly in WolframScript
statistics: G = dirac16complex: 16 complex anticommuting components, explicit Grassmann algebra with generators theta_1, theta_2 and their conjugates; C = dirac16complex00: 16 complex commuting components
coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times; x8 = the hidden direction; z = 6 H x8 in (0, Pi/2), H > 0

checks.name: zero_test_sanity
checks.detail: the exact zero test (field functions, their derivatives and U-expressions as independent polynomial variables; coefficients reduced with Sin z = w^6, w > 0, Cos^2 = 1 - Sin^2) returns True on identities and False on nonzero expressions in a set of control cases

checks.name: fixture_Clifford_relation
checks.detail: the gammas read from Revision/algebra/gammas.json satisfy {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab I16 with eta = diag(1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1,1) (order x1..x8), as recorded in the fixture

checks.name: fixture_C_B_S_consistent
checks.detail: C = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1) gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3) (real symmetric, C^2 = 1, C gamma^a antisymmetric), B = -i C gamma^(x4), Gamma = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1)...gamma^(x7), S^ab = (1/4)[gamma^a, gamma^b], all as decoded from the fixture

checks.name: metric_is_the_authors
checks.detail: g = e^T eta e with the diagonal vielbein e^a_mu = f_a delta^a_mu, f(x1,x2,x3) = E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), f(x4) = 1, f(x5,x6,x7) = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), f(x8) = Cot[z], z = 6 H x8, reproduces the author's metric of SPEC section 1 entry by entry

checks.name: vielbein_inverse
checks.detail: e^a_mu e_a^nu = delta and e_a^mu e_b^nu eta^ab = g^munu (inverse vielbein e_a^mu = delta_a^mu / f_a)

checks.name: sqrt_det_g_is_cos_z
checks.detail: det g = Cos[z]^2 (four negative entries), so sqrt|det g| = f1...f8 = Sin[z] Cot[z] = Cos[z] > 0 on 0 < z < Pi/2; it does not depend on x4: the 3-space inflation e^(3 a4) and the extra-time deflation e^(-3 a4) compensate in the volume

checks.name: degenerate_at_H_0
checks.detail: at fixed x8 and H -> 0+ the entries g11 = g22 = g33 -> 0, g55 = g66 = g77 -> 0 and g88 -> infinity: H = 0 is not a metric of the family (a degenerate limit); every statement below assumes H > 0 and 0 < z < Pi/2

checks.name: christoffel_count
checks.detail: the Levi-Civita connection has 25 independent nonzero symbols Gamma^l_mn (m <= n): listed in field-theory.json (christoffel_nonzero)

checks.name: ricci_scalar
checks.detail: Ricci scalar R = g^sn R^r_srn = 6 (a4'^2 - 7 H^2) (convention R^r_smn = d_m Gamma^r_ns - d_n Gamma^r_ms + Gamma^r_ml Gamma^l_ns - Gamma^r_nl Gamma^l_ms)

checks.name: never_flat_for_H_positive
checks.detail: R^(x8)_(x8) = -6 H^2 < 0 for every H > 0 and every function a4: the metric is curved for every admissible H, whatever a4 is (a4 constant included)

checks.name: vielbein_postulate
checks.detail: d_mu e^a_nu - Gamma^l_mu,nu e^a_l + omega_mu^a_b e^b_nu = 0 for all 512 components, with omega_mu^a_b = e^a_nu (d_mu e_b^nu + Gamma^nu_mu,l e_b^l)

checks.name: omega_antisymmetric
checks.detail: omega_mu,ab = eta_ac omega_mu^c_b = -omega_mu,ba (metric compatibility)

checks.name: omega_components
checks.detail: exactly 12 independent nonzero omega_mu,ab (a < b): for i = x1, x2, x3: omega_i,(i)(x4) = a4' E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), omega_i,(i)(x8) = H E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6); for t = x5, x6, x7: omega_t,(x4)(t) = -a4' E^-a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), omega_t,(t)(x8) = -H E^-a4 Sin[z]^(1/6); omega_x4 = omega_x8 = 0. Every component is a4' or H times a nonvanishing factor

checks.name: Omega_components
checks.detail: Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu,ab S^ab = sum_(a<b) omega_mu,ab (1/2) gamma^a gamma^b: Omega_xi = (1/2) E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6) (a4' gamma^(xi) gamma^(x4) + H gamma^(xi) gamma^(x8)) for i = 1, 2, 3; Omega_xt = -(1/2) E^-a4 Sin[z]^(1/6) (a4' gamma^(x4) gamma^(xt) + H gamma^(xt) gamma^(x8)) for t = 5, 6, 7; Omega_x4 = Omega_x8 = 0

checks.name: gamma_covariantly_constant
checks.detail: D_mu gamma^nu = d_mu gamma^nu + Gamma^nu_mu,l gamma^l + [Omega_mu, gamma^nu] = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu), gamma^nu = e_a^nu gamma^a (the canonical connection is the one that makes the gammas covariantly constant)

checks.name: S_rotates_gamma_with_omega
checks.detail: [Omega_mu, gamma^c] = -omega_mu^c_b gamma^b (the frame form of covariant constancy)

checks.name: spin_curvature_equals_Riemann
checks.detail: [D_mu, D_nu] Psi = (d_mu Omega_nu - d_nu Omega_mu + [Omega_mu, Omega_nu]) Psi = (1/2) R_ab,mu,nu S^ab Psi with R_ab,mu,nu = eta_aa e^a_r R^r_s,mu,nu e_b^s, all 28 pairs: the integrability (compatibility) condition of the spinor connection; it also shows that Omega cannot vanish in any frame unless the Riemann tensor vanishes (flat space)

checks.name: gammaOmega_equals_3H_gamma_x8
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) exactly (a constant matrix; independent of a4, x4 and x8)

checks.name: gammaOmega_x4_terms_cancel
checks.detail: per direction (no sum): gamma^(xi) Omega_xi = (a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) for each inflating 3-space direction i = 1, 2, 3, and gamma^(xt) Omega_xt = -(a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x8) for each deflating extra time t = 5, 6, 7; gamma^(x4) Omega_x4 = gamma^(x8) Omega_x8 = 0. The x4-direction (time) terms +3 a4'/2 (3 inflating) and -3 a4'/2 (3 deflating) cancel exactly; the hidden-direction terms of all six directions add: 6 x H/2 = 3 H

checks.name: gammaOmega_divergence_form
checks.detail: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu separately (Omega_mu contains only S^(mu b)), hence gamma^mu Omega_mu = (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_mu (sqrt g gamma^mu); for this metric (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_x8(sqrt g e_8^x8) gamma^(x8) = (1/(2 Cos z)) d_x8 (Sin z) gamma^(x8) = 3 H gamma^(x8), and d_x4 (sqrt g e_4^x4) = d_x4 Cos z = 0

checks.name: grassmann_algebra_structure
checks.detail: explicit Grassmann algebra on theta_1, theta_2, thetabar_1, thetabar_2: theta_i theta_j = -theta_j theta_i, theta_i^2 = 0, conj(theta_1 theta_2) = thetabar_2 thetabar_1, conj conj = id; Psi_A = sum_k ph[A,k](x) theta_k; L has components only on thetabar_k theta_l (bilinear) and theta_1 theta_2 thetabar_1 thetabar_2 (quartic); S = Psibar Psi is even with S^2 != 0 and S^3 = 0, so U = u1 S + (lam/2) S^2 is the most general potential

checks.name: L_real_G
checks.detail: L* = L exactly for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (the involution reverses the order of Grassmann factors; U = u1 S + (lam/2) S^2 with real u1, lam): C real symmetric, C gamma^a real antisymmetric and S^T C + C S = 0 make the symmetrised kinetic term and Psibar Psi real without a factor i

checks.name: L_real_C
checks.detail: L* = L exactly for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (ph <-> phc, i -> -i; U a real function): C real symmetric, C gamma^a real antisymmetric and S^T C + C S = 0 make the symmetrised kinetic term and Psibar Psi real without a factor i

checks.name: L_total_divergence_to_unsymmetrised_G
checks.detail: L = sqrt g [Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - m S - U] - (1/2) d_mu (sqrt g Psibar gamma^mu Psi) exactly, for dirac16complex (Grassmann): the two forms differ by a total divergence and give the same field equations

checks.name: L_total_divergence_to_unsymmetrised_C
checks.detail: L = sqrt g [Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - m S - U] - (1/2) d_mu (sqrt g Psibar gamma^mu Psi) exactly, for dirac16complex00 (commuting): the two forms differ by a total divergence and give the same field equations

checks.name: L_spin_connection_drops_out_G
checks.detail: for this diagonal metric Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0 term by term, so L = sqrt g [(1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U] exactly (dirac16complex (Grassmann)); the canonical spin connection reaches the field equations through d_mu(sqrt g gamma^mu) = 2 sqrt g gamma^mu Omega_mu (variation of the derivative terms), and the unsymmetrised form contains it explicitly

checks.name: L_spin_connection_drops_out_C
checks.detail: for this diagonal metric Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0 term by term, so L = sqrt g [(1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U] exactly (dirac16complex00 (commuting)); the canonical spin connection reaches the field equations through d_mu(sqrt g gamma^mu) = 2 sqrt g gamma^mu Omega_mu (variation of the derivative terms), and the unsymmetrised form contains it explicitly

checks.name: EL_Psibar_G
checks.detail: for every A = 1..16 and k = 1, 2: dL/dphc[A,k] - d_mu dL/d(d_mu phc[A,k]) = thetabar_k sqrt g (C E)_A with E = gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (m + U'(S)) Psi, U'(S) = u1 + lam S (explicit Grassmann algebra): the field equation is gamma^mu D_mu Psi = (m + U'(S)) Psi

checks.name: EL_Psi_G
checks.detail: for every A, k: dL/dph[A,k] - d_mu dL/d(d_mu ph[A,k]) = theta_k sqrt g Ebar_A with Ebar = (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu + (m + U'(S)) Psibar (sign from moving theta_k to the left): the adjoint equation (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu = -(m + U'(S)) Psibar

checks.name: EL_Psibar_C
checks.detail: for every A = 1..16: dL/dPhi*_A - d_mu dL/d(d_mu Phi*_A) = sqrt g (C E)_A with E = gamma^mu D_mu Phi - (m + U'(S)) Phi (general U): the field equation is gamma^mu D_mu Phi = (m + U'(S)) Phi

checks.name: EL_Psi_C
checks.detail: for every A: dL/dPhi_A - d_mu dL/d(d_mu Phi_A) = -sqrt g Ebar_A with Ebar = (D_mu Phibar) gamma^mu + (m + U'(S)) Phibar: the adjoint equation (D_mu Phibar) gamma^mu = -(m + U'(S)) Phibar

checks.name: adjoint_equation_is_Dirac_conjugate_G
checks.detail: E^dagger C = -Ebar exactly for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (uses C gamma^a C = -(gamma^a)^T, Omega^T C = -C Omega, U' real): the adjoint equation is the Dirac conjugate of the field equation

checks.name: adjoint_equation_is_Dirac_conjugate_C
checks.detail: E^dagger C = -Ebar exactly for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (uses C gamma^a C = -(gamma^a)^T, Omega^T C = -C Omega, U' real): the adjoint equation is the Dirac conjugate of the field equation

checks.name: Dirac_operator_explicit_G
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (gamma^(x1) d1 + gamma^(x2) d2 + gamma^(x3) d3) Psi + gamma^(x4) d4 Psi + E^a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (gamma^(x5) d5 + gamma^(x6) d6 + gamma^(x7) d7) Psi + Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 Psi + 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi, for dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: Dirac_operator_explicit_C
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (gamma^(x1) d1 + gamma^(x2) d2 + gamma^(x3) d3) Psi + gamma^(x4) d4 Psi + E^a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (gamma^(x5) d5 + gamma^(x6) d6 + gamma^(x7) d7) Psi + Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 Psi + 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi, for dirac16complex00 (commuting)

checks.name: block_form
checks.detail: every gamma^a = {{0, tb_a}, {t_a, 0}} is block off-diagonal in the chiral split Psi = (psi_-, psi_+) (Gamma = diag(-1, 1)): the field equation is the pair sum_a (1/f_a) tb_a d_a psi_+ + 3 H tb_8 psi_+ = V psi_- and sum_a (1/f_a) t_a d_a psi_- + 3 H t_8 psi_- = V psi_+ (blocks in field-theory.json)

checks.name: evolution_form_G
checks.detail: (gamma^(x4))^2 = -1, so the field equation is equivalent to the first-order evolution equation d4 Psi = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != 4) (1/f_a) gamma^(a) d_a Psi - 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi] (exact: gamma^(x4) (d4 Psi - RHS) = E): the slices x4 = const are non-characteristic (g^44 = -1 != 0), dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: evolution_form_C
checks.detail: (gamma^(x4))^2 = -1, so the field equation is equivalent to the first-order evolution equation d4 Psi = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != 4) (1/f_a) gamma^(a) d_a Psi - 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi] (exact: gamma^(x4) (d4 Psi - RHS) = E): the slices x4 = const are non-characteristic (g^44 = -1 != 0), dirac16complex00 (commuting)

checks.name: nontriviality_1_dirac16complex
checks.detail: NON-TRIVIALITY [1] for dirac16complex (Grassmann): the spin-connection part of the Euler-Lagrange equation is exactly (gamma^mu D_mu - gamma^mu d_mu) Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi, nonzero for every H > 0 and every a4 (a4 constant included) and every Psi != 0 (gamma^(x8) is invertible); in addition the vielbein enters every derivative term, gamma^mu d_mu = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) gamma^(xi) d_i + gamma^(x4) d4 + E^a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) gamma^(xt) d_t + Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 (none of the factors is identically 1). The a4'-terms of the spin connection cancel between the 3 inflating and the 3 deflating directions (check gammaOmega_x4_terms_cancel); a4 enters through the vielbein factors E^-+a4 of the 3-space and extra-time derivatives. All gravitational terms vanish together only if Omega_mu = 0 for all mu, which by spin_curvature_equals_Riemann requires a flat metric; R^(x8)_(x8) = -6 H^2 shows the metric is never flat for H > 0 (H = 0 itself is a degenerate limit, check degenerate_at_H_0)

checks.name: nontriviality_2_dirac16complex00
checks.detail: NON-TRIVIALITY [2] for dirac16complex00 (commuting): the spin-connection part of the Euler-Lagrange equation is exactly (gamma^mu D_mu - gamma^mu d_mu) Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = 3 H gamma^(x8) Psi, nonzero for every H > 0 and every a4 (a4 constant included) and every Psi != 0 (gamma^(x8) is invertible); in addition the vielbein enters every derivative term, gamma^mu d_mu = E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) gamma^(xi) d_i + gamma^(x4) d4 + E^a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) gamma^(xt) d_t + Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 (none of the factors is identically 1). The a4'-terms of the spin connection cancel between the 3 inflating and the 3 deflating directions (check gammaOmega_x4_terms_cancel); a4 enters through the vielbein factors E^-+a4 of the 3-space and extra-time derivatives. All gravitational terms vanish together only if Omega_mu = 0 for all mu, which by spin_curvature_equals_Riemann requires a flat metric; R^(x8)_(x8) = -6 H^2 shows the metric is never flat for H > 0 (H = 0 itself is a degenerate limit, check degenerate_at_H_0)

checks.name: Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_and_H_vanish
checks.detail: each of the 12 nonzero omega_mu,ab is either a4' or H times a factor +-E^(+-a4) Sin[z]^(1/6) that never vanishes on 0 < z < Pi/2: the a4'-part of Omega_mu vanishes iff a4 is constant and its H-part iff H = 0; for H > 0 the spin connection never vanishes

checks.name: current_real_G
checks.detail: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi is real (Hermitian) for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (-i C gamma^a is Hermitian)

checks.name: current_conservation_identity_G
checks.detail: d_mu (sqrt g J^mu) = -i sqrt g (Ebar Psi + Psibar E) exactly (off shell), so nabla_mu J^mu = 0 on shell, for dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: charge_density_is_Krein_form_G
checks.detail: J^(x4) = Psi^dagger B Psi with B = -i C gamma^(x4) (Hermitian, signature (8,8)): the conserved charge Q = integral of Cos[z] Psi^dagger B Psi d^7x is an indefinite form, dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: current_real_C
checks.detail: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi is real (Hermitian) for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (-i C gamma^a is Hermitian)

checks.name: current_conservation_identity_C
checks.detail: d_mu (sqrt g J^mu) = -i sqrt g (Ebar Psi + Psibar E) exactly (off shell), so nabla_mu J^mu = 0 on shell, for dirac16complex00 (commuting)

checks.name: charge_density_is_Krein_form_C
checks.detail: J^(x4) = Psi^dagger B Psi with B = -i C gamma^(x4) (Hermitian, signature (8,8)): the conserved charge Q = integral of Cos[z] Psi^dagger B Psi d^7x is an indefinite form, dirac16complex00 (commuting)

checks.name: Lichnerowicz_identity_G
checks.detail: (gamma^mu D_mu)^2 Psi = g^mu,nu (D_mu D_nu Psi - Gamma^l_mu,nu D_l Psi) - (R/4) Psi with R = 6 (a4'^2 - 7 H^2), for a general dirac16complex (Grassmann) (exact): the second-order consequence of the field equations is consistent with the curvature (integrability)

checks.name: Lichnerowicz_identity_C
checks.detail: (gamma^mu D_mu)^2 Psi = g^mu,nu (D_mu D_nu Psi - Gamma^l_mu,nu D_l Psi) - (R/4) Psi with R = 6 (a4'^2 - 7 H^2), for a general dirac16complex00 (commuting) (exact): the second-order consequence of the field equations is consistent with the curvature (integrability)

checks.name: Majorana_Lg_total_derivative_grassmann
checks.detail: for REAL anticommuting components Psi_A = sum_k phr[A,k](x) theta_k (explicit Grassmann algebra, N = 2): sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu D_mu Psi = d_mu ((1/2) sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu Psi) exactly; it is not zero, but it is a total derivative: all 32 Euler-Lagrange expressions vanish identically (no field equation). Also Psi^T C Psi = 0 (C symmetric). This is why the notebook's Majorana-type Lg[] cannot serve and the Dirac-type L with Psibar = Psi^dagger C is used

checks.name: Majorana_Lg_commuting_control
checks.detail: control: for REAL COMMUTING components the same Lg gives the nontrivial Euler-Lagrange expression 2 sqrt g (C gamma^mu D_mu Phi)_A (a massless equation) while Phi^T C gamma^mu Phi = 0 identically: Lg is a total derivative exactly for anticommuting real components

checks.name: T_vielbein_variation_closed_form_G
checks.detail: for all 64 components (dirac16complex (Grassmann)), T^nu_mu := e^b_mu (1/sqrt g) delta S / delta e^b_nu (exact first-order variation of sqrt g, gamma^mu and the spin connection, functional derivative in h(x)) equals delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/2)(Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi) - (1/4) g_mu,rho nabla_l (Psibar {gamma^l, Sigma^(nu rho)} Psi), Sigma^(nu rho) = (1/4)[gamma^nu, gamma^rho], L0 = L/sqrt g; the last term (totally antisymmetric spin density) comes from the variation of the spin connection

checks.name: T_symmetric_part_Belinfante_G
checks.detail: the symmetric part of the variation tensor, (T^(nu rho) + T^(rho nu))/2, equals T_sym^(nu rho) = g^(nu rho) L0 - (1/4)(Psibar gamma^nu D^rho Psi + Psibar gamma^rho D^nu Psi - D^rho Psibar gamma^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma^rho Psi) for all 36 pairs (dirac16complex (Grassmann))

checks.name: T_vielbein_variation_closed_form_C
checks.detail: for all 64 components (dirac16complex00 (commuting)), T^nu_mu := e^b_mu (1/sqrt g) delta S / delta e^b_nu (exact first-order variation of sqrt g, gamma^mu and the spin connection, functional derivative in h(x)) equals delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/2)(Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi) - (1/4) g_mu,rho nabla_l (Psibar {gamma^l, Sigma^(nu rho)} Psi), Sigma^(nu rho) = (1/4)[gamma^nu, gamma^rho], L0 = L/sqrt g; the last term (totally antisymmetric spin density) comes from the variation of the spin connection

checks.name: T_symmetric_part_Belinfante_C
checks.detail: the symmetric part of the variation tensor, (T^(nu rho) + T^(rho nu))/2, equals T_sym^(nu rho) = g^(nu rho) L0 - (1/4)(Psibar gamma^nu D^rho Psi + Psibar gamma^rho D^nu Psi - D^rho Psibar gamma^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma^rho Psi) for all 36 pairs (dirac16complex00 (commuting))

checks.name: Noether_identity_diffeomorphisms_G
checks.detail: for each lambda = x1..x8 (dirac16complex (Grassmann), general fields, off shell): d_mu (sqrt g T^mu_lambda) - sqrt g T^mu_a d_lambda e^a_mu = sum over all component functions phi of EL_phi d_lambda phi (EL_phi = the Euler-Lagrange expression of phi); this is the identity of the invariance of the action under coordinate changes

checks.name: Noether_identity_local_Lorentz_G
checks.detail: for all 28 frame rotations lambda_ab = -lambda_ba (dirac16complex (Grassmann), off shell): sqrt g T^mu_a lambda^a_c e^c_mu + sum_phi EL_phi delta phi = 0 with delta e^a_mu = lambda^a_c e^c_mu, delta Psi = +(1/2) lambda_ab S^ab Psi, delta Psibar = -(1/2) lambda_ab Psibar S^ab (the spinor rotation that keeps Psibar gamma^mu Psi invariant): the antisymmetric part T^[ab] is a combination of the Euler-Lagrange expressions, so T^mu_nu is symmetric on shell and equals T_sym

checks.name: Noether_identity_diffeomorphisms_C
checks.detail: for each lambda = x1..x8 (dirac16complex00 (commuting), general fields, off shell): d_mu (sqrt g T^mu_lambda) - sqrt g T^mu_a d_lambda e^a_mu = sum over all component functions phi of EL_phi d_lambda phi (EL_phi = the Euler-Lagrange expression of phi); this is the identity of the invariance of the action under coordinate changes

checks.name: Noether_identity_local_Lorentz_C
checks.detail: for all 28 frame rotations lambda_ab = -lambda_ba (dirac16complex00 (commuting), off shell): sqrt g T^mu_a lambda^a_c e^c_mu + sum_phi EL_phi delta phi = 0 with delta e^a_mu = lambda^a_c e^c_mu, delta Psi = +(1/2) lambda_ab S^ab Psi, delta Psibar = -(1/2) lambda_ab Psibar S^ab (the spinor rotation that keeps Psibar gamma^mu Psi invariant): the antisymmetric part T^[ab] is a combination of the Euler-Lagrange expressions, so T^mu_nu is symmetric on shell and equals T_sym

checks.name: conservation_on_shell_general
checks.detail: consequence for both statistics: on shell (all EL_phi = 0) T^mu_nu = T_sym^mu_nu is symmetric and d_mu(sqrt g T^mu_lambda) - sqrt g T^mu_a d_lambda e^a_mu = 0, which for symmetric T is sqrt g nabla_mu T^mu_lambda = 0 (Gamma^r_mu,lambda T^mu_r = (1/2) d_lambda g_mu,r T^mu r = T^mu_a d_lambda e^a_mu): exact conservation for general solutions

checks.name: T_diagonal_components_G
checks.detail: T^mu_mu (no sum) = L0 - K_mu with K_mu = (1/(2 f_mu)) (Psibar gamma^(mu) d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^(mu) Psi): no spin-connection term survives in the diagonal components (Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0); the variation tensor and T_sym agree on the diagonal (dirac16complex (Grassmann))

checks.name: EMT_trace_G
checks.detail: trace T^mu_mu (sum) = 7 sum_mu K_mu - 8 (m S + U(S)) exactly (dirac16complex (Grassmann)); with kinetic_sum_on_shell it is -m S + 7 S U' - 8 U on shell

checks.name: kinetic_sum_on_shell_G
checks.detail: L0 = sum_mu K_mu - m S - U(S) and sum_mu K_mu = (m + U'(S)) S + (1/2)(Psibar E - Ebar Psi) exactly (dirac16complex (Grassmann)): on shell the total kinetic term is (m + U'(S)) S and L0 = S U'(S) - U(S)

checks.name: T_diagonal_components_C
checks.detail: T^mu_mu (no sum) = L0 - K_mu with K_mu = (1/(2 f_mu)) (Psibar gamma^(mu) d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^(mu) Psi): no spin-connection term survives in the diagonal components (Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0); the variation tensor and T_sym agree on the diagonal (dirac16complex00 (commuting))

checks.name: EMT_trace_C
checks.detail: trace T^mu_mu (sum) = 7 sum_mu K_mu - 8 (m S + U(S)) exactly (dirac16complex00 (commuting)); with kinetic_sum_on_shell it is -m S + 7 S U' - 8 U on shell

checks.name: kinetic_sum_on_shell_C
checks.detail: L0 = sum_mu K_mu - m S - U(S) and sum_mu K_mu = (m + U'(S)) S + (1/2)(Psibar E - Ebar Psi) exactly (dirac16complex00 (commuting)): on shell the total kinetic term is (m + U'(S)) S and L0 = S U'(S) - U(S)

checks.name: energy_exchange_equation
checks.detail: for a diagonal homogeneous T^mu_nu = diag(p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t, p8) depending on x4 only: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -rho' - 3 a4' (p3 - p_t); conservation gives d rho/d x4 = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t): energy flows between 3-space and the extra times unless p3 = p_t (sqrt g does not depend on x4)

checks.name: solution_matrix_square
checks.detail: M = -m gamma^(x4) + mu gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8) satisfies M^2 = (mu^2 - m^2) I16 and M^T C + C M = 0, so exp(M x4) = Cosh[k x4] I + (Sinh[k x4]/k) M with k^2 = mu^2 - m^2 and every bilinear chi^dagger C exp(M x4)... is constant

checks.name: exact_solution_x4_x8_G
checks.detail: exact solution (dirac16complex (Grassmann), U = 0): Psi = Sin[z]^al (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi with constant chi (16 free complex constants per Grassmann generator), M = -m gamma^(x4) + 3 H (2 al + 1) gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8), k^2 = 9 H^2 (2 al + 1)^2 - m^2, al arbitrary; it satisfies the field equation for every a4 (a test of the terms Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 and 3 H gamma^(x8)), and nabla_mu T_sym^mu_nu = 0 for all 8 nu and d_mu(sqrt g J^mu) = 0 hold exactly at it. Honest scope: at these solutions the pressures and the momentum density vanish (on shell L0 = 0 for U = 0, K_mu = 0 for mu != x4, T^x4_x8 = 0) and rho = -T^x4_x4 = m S is constant in x4, so the conservation test is weak; the general proof is the pair of Noether identities

checks.name: exact_solution_x4_x8_C
checks.detail: exact solution (dirac16complex00 (commuting), U = 0): Psi = Sin[z]^al (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi with constant chi (16 free complex constants), M = -m gamma^(x4) + 3 H (2 al + 1) gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8), k^2 = 9 H^2 (2 al + 1)^2 - m^2, al arbitrary; it satisfies the field equation for every a4 (a test of the terms Tan[z] gamma^(x8) d8 and 3 H gamma^(x8)), and nabla_mu T_sym^mu_nu = 0 for all 8 nu and d_mu(sqrt g J^mu) = 0 hold exactly at it. Honest scope: at these solutions the pressures and the momentum density vanish (on shell L0 = 0 for U = 0, K_mu = 0 for mu != x4, T^x4_x8 = 0) and rho = -T^x4_x4 = m S is constant in x4, so the conservation test is weak; the general proof is the pair of Noether identities

checks.name: exact_solution_nonlinear_homogeneous_C
checks.detail: exact nonlinear solution of dirac16complex00 with U = (lam/2) S^2: Phi = (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi, M = -(m + lam S0) gamma^(x4) + 3 H gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8), S0 = chi^dagger C chi, k^2 = 9 H^2 - (m + lam S0)^2 (checked with the effective mass m + lam S0 as the parameter): S = S0 is constant, the field equation holds, nabla_mu T^mu_nu = 0 for all nu, and the diagonal components are T^x4_x4 = -rho, T^mu_mu = p (mu != x4) with rho = m S0 + lam S0^2/2 = m S + U, p = lam S0^2/2 = S U' - U exactly (homogeneous on-shell forms)

checks.name: exact_solution_nonlinear_homogeneous_G
checks.detail: exact nonlinear solution of dirac16complex (explicit Grassmann algebra, N = 2) with U = (lam/2) S^2: Psi = sum_k [exp(M_m x4) + lam S0 d/dm exp(M_m x4)] chi_k theta_k with S0 = sum_kl thetabar_k theta_l chi_k^dagger C chi_l (the expansion of exp(M_(m + lam S0) x4) terminates because S0^2 Psi = 0): S = S0 (even, nilpotent, S0^2 != 0), the field equation holds, nabla_mu T^mu_nu = 0, rho = m S0 + (lam/2) S0^2 and p3 = p_t = p8 = (lam/2) S0^2 as Grassmann-algebra elements (the classical Grassmann EMT; its numbers come from the quantum expectation values of section 6)

checks.name: canonical_momentum
checks.detail: dL/d(d4 ph[A,k]) = pi_A theta_k with pi_A = (1/2) Cos[z] (Psi^dagger C gamma^(x4))_A = (i/2) Cos[z] (Psi^dagger B)_A (the momentum conjugate to Psi_A as a right derivative; C gamma^(x4) = i B): pi depends on Psi^dagger only, a second-class constraint as for Dirac's field

checks.name: first_order_form_and_anticommutator
checks.detail: up to a total divergence L = Psi^dagger K d4 Psi - (terms without d4), K = Cos[z] C gamma^(x4) = i Cos[z] B (C gamma^(x4) anti-Hermitian with i (C gamma^(x4))^-1 = B; invertible since g^44 != 0); the canonical (Dirac-bracket) anticommutator is {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)} = i (K^-1)_AC delta^7(x - y) = B_AC delta^7(x - y)/sqrt|g| on a slice x4 = const (exact: i K^-1 = B/Cos[z])

checks.name: Heisenberg_equation_reproduces_field_equation
checks.detail: with the Hamiltonian density Hd = Cos[z] [Psi^dagger (m C - sum_(a != 4) C gamma^a D_a) Psi + U(S)] (so that the unsymmetrised L = Psi^dagger K d4 Psi - Hd exactly) and {Psi, Psi^dagger} = B delta^7/sqrt g, the Heisenberg equation d4 Psi = i[H, Psi] = -i B (1/sqrt g) dHd/dPsi^dagger equals -gamma^(x4) [(m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != 4) gamma^a D_a Psi], the field equation solved for d4 Psi (exact, general U; the operator ordering of U'(S) Psi is that of the classical expression)

checks.name: no_positive_inner_product
checks.detail: B is Hermitian with eigenvalues +1 (x8) and -1 (x8); for the exact unit vector u = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, (-I)/Sqrt[2], 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1/Sqrt[2]} (B u = -u) the smeared operator X = sum_A u_A^* Psi_A(f) has {X, X^dagger} = (u^dagger B u) ||f||^2 = -||f||^2. If Psi^dagger were the adjoint in a space with positive inner product, {X, X^dagger} = X X^dagger + X^dagger X would be a positive operator (<phi|{X,X^dagger}|phi> = ||X^dagger phi||^2 + ||X phi||^2 >= 0): contradiction. Hence the canonical anticommutator in signature (4,4) forces an indefinite (Krein) inner product; the positive representation uses the Hilbert adjoint chi = Psi^dagger B with {Psi_A, chi_C} = (B B)_AC = delta_AC

checks.name: mode_hamiltonian_good_sector
checks.detail: frozen-coefficient (flat-frame) plane waves Psi = u exp(i k.x - i E x4): E u = h_k u with h_k = m beta + sum_a k_a alpha^a, beta = -i gamma^(x4), alpha^a = -gamma^(x4) gamma^a; beta and alpha^(x1,x2,x3,x8) are Hermitian, alpha^(x5,x6,x7) anti-Hermitian, {alpha^a, alpha^b} = 2 delta^ab (-eta^44 eta^aa), {alpha, beta} = 0, beta^2 = 1; h_k^2 = (m^2 + k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 + k8^2 - k5^2 - k6^2 - k7^2) I, Tr h_k = 0. In the GOOD SECTOR (k5 = k6 = k7 = 0, nothing depends on the extra times) h_k is Hermitian with real eigenvalues +-E (8 each); with extra-time momentum E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2 is negative for k_t^2 > m^2 + k_s^2: those modes grow exponentially in x4

checks.name: mode_hamiltonian_Krein_selfadjoint
checks.detail: B h_k = h_k^dagger B for all real m, k (h_k^dagger taken with m, k real; the Krein norm u^dagger B u is conserved by every mode, also those that grow); the mode Hamiltonian density is Psi^dagger (m C - i C k_a gamma^a) Psi = chi h_k Psi with chi = Psi^dagger B (B m C = m beta, B (-i C gamma^a) = alpha^a)

checks.name: good_sector_hermiticity_curved
checks.detail: the curved mode operator h = m (-i gamma^(x4)) + sum_(a != 4) (1/f_a) i gamma^(x4) gamma^(a) d_a + 3 i H gamma^(x4) gamma^(x8) (i d4 Psi = h Psi for U = 0) satisfies, for general u, v, Cos[z] (u^dagger h v - (h u)^dagger v) = sum_(a = 1,2,3,8) d_a (Cos[z]/f_a u^dagger M_a v) + sum_(t = 5,6,7) (Cos[z]/f_t)(u^dagger M_t d_t v - d_t u^dagger M_t v), M_a = i gamma^(x4) gamma^(a): h is Hermitian for the measure Cos[z] d^7x exactly in the GOOD SECTOR (no extra-time dependence); without the spin-connection term 3 H gamma^(x8) a remainder -6 H Cos[z] u^dagger M_8 v survives (Cos[z] [p (Tan z d8 + 3H) q + ((Tan z d8 + 3H) p) q] = d8 (Sin[z] p q)): the gravitational term is exactly what makes the hidden-direction operator Hermitian

checks.name: Krein_form_conserved_curved
checks.detail: Cos[z] (u^dagger B h v - (h u)^dagger B v) = sum_(a != 4) d_a (Cos[z]/f_a u^dagger B M_a v) for general u, v (all seven slice directions): h is self-adjoint for the Krein form integral Cos[z] u^dagger B v d^7x in the whole theory

checks.name: Fock_space_good_sector_example
checks.detail: explicit fermionic Fock space (2^16 occupation states, positive inner product) for one good-sector momentum, m = 3, k = (4, 0, 0, 0) along x1, E = 5: Psi = sum_s (b_s u_s + d_s^* v_s) with exact orthonormal eigenvectors of h_k (completeness U U^dagger = I, so {Psi_A, chi_C} = delta_AC); the Hamiltonian chi h_k Psi has vacuum value -8 E (the filled sea), normal-ordered energy +E for the particle b_0^*|0> AND for the antiparticle d_0^*|0>; charge Psi^dagger B Psi = chi Psi gives +1 and -1; the expectation-value rule <u|:Psi^dagger M Psi:|u> = u^dagger B M u (particle) and -v^dagger B M v (antiparticle) holds exactly for M = C, -i C gamma^(x4), -i C gamma^(x1), C gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3) and a dense integer matrix
